text:
Casey Wu: Hey team — I clicked the org invite but GH keeps bouncing me between my personal and work accounts. The invite link opens showing my personal username and a big "switch accounts" button.

Nora (DevEx): Hi Casey, welcome! That usually happens when the work email is attached to two accounts. Which email did we invite?

Casey Wu: invite was sent to casey@redwood.ai. My personal account also has that email on file (old dev account).

IT Helpdesk: If you want to keep the personal account separate, we can remove the stale pending membership and resend to casey@redwood.ai. Quick questions: do you have 2FA enabled on the work account?

Casey Wu: I think so but not 100% — I'll check.

Onboarding Bot: Checklist update: GitHub invite received.

Casey Wu: 2FA was off. Enabled it now via an authenticator app.

Nora (DevEx): OK, two steps that usually fix this: 1) Sign out of all GitHub sessions in the browser or use an incognito window; 2) Accept the invite while logged into the work account and then click the blue "Authorize SSO" button on the org page.

Casey Wu: Did that, but after authorizing SSO the web UI still shows me as an "Outside collaborator" and I can't see private repos. Clone returns 404.

IT Helpdesk: Sounds like the invite mapped to the personal account despite SSO. I'll unlink the personal account from the pending invite and resend. Would you like us to resend now?

Casey Wu: Yes please, resend to work account. Also my local git is using my personal SSH key by default — will that break anything?

Nora (DevEx): If your private key is on the personal GH account, you'll need to add your public key to the work account (https://github.com/settings/keys) or point ssh to the correct key via ~/.ssh/config. Example config:

```
Host github.com
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_rsa_work
```

Casey Wu: Thanks — added key to work account.

IT Helpdesk: Invite resent to casey@redwood.ai. Accept it in an incognito window while signed into the work account.

Casey Wu: Accepted! Now org shows "Member" and I can see team repos. Ran `ssh -T git@github.com` and got "Hi casey! You've successfully authenticated"

Ben (Eng Lead): Welcome Casey :tada: If you still get push denied, check the team mapping — some repos grant push via specific teams. Ping me or Nora and we can add you to the right team.

Casey Wu: One last weird thing — my personal account still lists my work email. Should I remove it to avoid future collisions?

Nora (DevEx): Recommended: remove the work email from personal account (https://github.com/settings/emails). If you need to keep it for OSS, we can instead add a note to the invite flow, but removing is cleaner.

Casey Wu: Removed it from the personal account. All good now. Thanks everyone for the quick help!

Onboarding Bot: Checklist update: GitHub access confirmed.

Nora (DevEx): Welcome aboard Casey! If you want the starter issues and repo map, DM me and I'll drop the onboarding checklist and the PR template.
